subject: Phase 0 - foundation: repo scaffolding, toolchain, CI, hooks, config, logging, CLI, ADRs, docs
conditions: CI passes on the first or second attempt
source: docs/reports/phase-0.md plan, stated before any file was created

subject: Phase 1 - data model and store: pydantic records, typed ids, SQLite schema and migrations, graph edge table, repository layer, audit trail, property tests
conditions: the SQLite-under-OneDrive question is settled early rather than debugged late
hypothesis example counts are bounded before the store tests enter the pre-commit loop
calibration_note: No correction applied. The only prior is scaffolding at n=1, BiasDetective refuses below n=5, and this is a different work class - applying Phase 0's 2.3x over-estimate here would be the unprincipled adjustment this product exists to replace.
source: docs/reports/NEXT.md, written at the close of Phase 0 before any Phase 1 file was created

subject: Phase 2 - LLM provider abstraction: the LLMProvider seam, MockProvider with a response library rich enough for the phase 3-8 agents, ReplayProvider, AnthropicProvider, structured output with a bounded repair loop, token and cost accounting, and the trace store
conditions: the tests are priced as line items rather than assumed to follow the feature - roughly 3,000 test lines against roughly 2,200 production lines, which is the lesson OUT-0002 recorded
the mock response library for DecisionScout, AssumptionExtractor, EstimateExtractor, WorkClassifier and OutcomeMatcher is inside this estimate, not deferred to phase 3
no live API call is made and no key exists, so AnthropicProvider is tested against an injected stub client only
two ADRs and the phase report are inside this estimate
the trace table is added to the phase 1 store rather than becoming a second persistence mechanism
calibration_note: No bias correction applied, again. The two priors disagree in direction - scaffolding over-estimated 2.3x at n=1, data-modelling under-estimated 2.1x at n=1 - and this is a third work class. BiasDetective refuses to answer below n=5; applying a factor here would be the unprincipled adjustment this product exists to replace, and it would be the author breaking his own product's rule at the first opportunity. A scope correction WAS applied and is a different thing: OUT-0002 showed the estimate priced the feature and not the tests that make it trustworthy, so this estimate prices both explicitly in its conditions. If Phase 2 still runs long, the conditions say where to look.
source: docs/reports/NEXT.md phase 2 plan, stated on the phase branch before any praxis/llm file was created

subject: Phase 3 - ingestion and segmentation: SourceAdapter for markdown/text/json, the deterministic block grid, the structured-output layer and its repair loop deferred from phase 2, SegmenterAgent, VerifierAgent, the synthetic corpus generator and its machine-gradeable ground truth format, and the end-to-end ingestion pipeline with tracing
conditions: the tests are priced as line items and weighted toward the ones that can fail - roughly 1,900 production lines against roughly 2,600 test lines, with property tests over the block grid, a multi-seed loop over the generator and adversarial span fixtures inside that figure rather than assertions that pass on the first try
the structured-output layer and its bounded repair loop are inside this estimate, having been deferred from phase 2 to the first agent that needs one
the synthetic corpus generator is inside this estimate rather than deferred to phase 10, because phase 3's own tests use it as fixture data
no schema migration is needed: the document and span tables already exist, and no new FindingKind member is introduced, so rejected spans are reported rather than stored
the segmenter's deterministic degradation floor is built before its LLM path, so a bad model answer cannot block the phase
no live API call is made and no key exists; MockProvider serves every call, and malformed_share is what the repair loop is tested against
two ADRs and the phase report are inside this estimate
calibration_note: No bias correction applied, for the fourth time and the same reason. Three outcomes exist in three work classes and they disagree in direction - scaffolding over 2.3x, data-modelling under 2.1x, llm-integration under 1.24x, n = 1 each - and this is a fourth class again. BiasDetective refuses to answer below n = 5; applying a factor here would be the unprincipled adjustment this product exists to replace, and it would be the author breaking his own product's rule at the first opportunity. The scope correction OUT-0002 asked for and OUT-0003 confirmed IS applied, and it is a different thing: the conditions price the tests as line items, and this time they also price which tests, following the phase 2 report's closing note that the tests which found real defects were the ones built on real objects and many seeds rather than one.
shape_note: First estimate to carry active_quantity and blocked_quantity as separate fields rather than a single quantity with a measure, matching the Estimate record's own shape. EST-0001 through EST-0003 predate that record being the reference.
source: docs/reports/NEXT.md phase 3 plan, stated on the phase branch before any praxis/ingest file was created
